Arens_Eells_normal_trace_technology_audi.possible_use: AE(partial E) is a natural fixed signed BL trace target for the Round54 directional-BV and synchronised-pairing sublayers
Arens_Eells_normal_trace_technology_audi.relevant_typed_result: the normal trace of an extended divergence-measure field lies in the Arens-Eells space AE(partial E), the predual of bounded Lipschitz functions; on locally uniformly quasiconvex domains, including Lipschitz domains, the trace map is onto and has a bounded not-necessarily-linear right inverse, with an analogous DM^1 statement

source.author: Christopher Irving
source.title: On the normal trace space of extended divergence-measure fields

Arens_Eells_normal_trace_technology_audi.why_no_promotion: the result supplies neither positivity nor a linear Markov extension, same-ID killed-word intertwining, numeric billiard constants, membership of every physical source in the divergence-measure class, nor a rho-rate

newly_certified_sublayers: source-synchronised hit/miss BL coupling with exact marginals
Gate5_maturity_update.reason_no_new_field_credit: the physical same-source rate, weak clearance moment, same-operator Round54/Round42 join and unbounded suffix horizon are all missing

analytic_transverse_full_mass_collar_sep.dyadic_level: C_k={t:2^(-k)<=abs(t)<2^(-(k-1))}, k>=1; the Round54 selector has ell(t)=2^(-(k+1)) on C_k
analytic_transverse_full_mass_collar_sep.finite_parent_debt: if every parent curve has length one and owner rank B=14, then Z_parent=1 and Z_parent,B=2^14=16384
analytic_transverse_full_mass_collar_sep.logical_conclusion: even full A_col trace mass, a null zero-clearance set and analytic transversality do not imply finite Z_col or a uniformly proper trace bridge
analytic_transverse_full_mass_collar_sep.model: owner/root parameter t in (-1,1) with probability nu=dt/2; the selected anchor face is b_0(t)=0 and one other analytic boundary is b_1(t)=t, so the two boundaries have one transverse crossing at t=0 and d(t)=abs(t) away from it
analytic_transverse_full_mass_collar_sep.no_grazing_accumulation: there is exactly one analytic transverse zero of the clearance and no countable homogeneity-shell accumulation in this separator

dyadic_debt_layer_delayed_recovery.abstract_layer_typing: C_k={omega:k(omega)=k}, nu_k=nu restricted to C_k, m_k=mass(nu_k), and the Round54 constant-density collar extension has z_(k,0)=2^(k+1)*m_k
dyadic_debt_layer_delayed_recovery.clearance_tail_sufficient_condition: if nu({0<d<t})<=C_d*t^alpha for 0<t<=1 and total mass is M, then M_col,w<=w_Z*M+C_d*w_Z^2/(1-w_Z*2^(-alpha)) whenever w_Z*2^(-alpha)<1
dyadic_debt_layer_delayed_recovery.required_same_operator_hypothesis: the actual labelled Round54 killed-word collar output on C_k is an input to the exact Round42 positive killed C24 operator O_s^9148, with the same owner IDs and no relabelling or unregistered boundary cut
dyadic_debt_layer_delayed_recovery.required_suffix_horizon: level k retains at least k+1 consecutive compatible 9148-collision C24 blocks after its insertion; mass is nonincreasing, m_(k,r)<=m_k
dyadic_debt_layer_delayed_recovery.strictly_weaker_than_Z_col: for the analytic transverse separator m_k=2^(-k), k>=1, Z_col=infinity but M_col,w=w_Z^2/(2-w_Z)<infinity

provenance.claim_type: alternative synchronised signed pairing with a never-worse minimum bound, sharp full-mass collar separator, and conditional dyadic delayed-recovery interface
provenance.parameter_scope: the abstract coupling is recordwise; the delayed C24 theorem has the Round42 fixed |s|<=1/400 scope; no moving-sequence theorem is asserted

synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.Borel_typing: products and parameter integrals of the two fixed standard-Borel Markov kernels are Borel; no measurable selection or cross-source pairing occurs
synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.comparison_scope: the synchronised and normalized-product costs are not totally ordered; only their minimum is certified never worse than either chosen witness
synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.deterministic_reduction: if H_p(x)=delta_(h_p(x)) and M_p(x)=delta_(m_p(x)), then d_p^sync=integral min(2,d(h_p(x),m_p(x))) d abs(lambda_p)(x)

no_automatic_rate_separator.conclusion: equal positive mass and constant-test cancellation alone imply no delta_sync<1 image-separation rate
no_automatic_rate_separator.model: for every p use one source atom of mass one with deterministic h_p(x)=0 and m_p(x)=1 in the fixed two-point metric

product_coupling_nonsharp_separator.conclusion: the Round54 normalized-product witness is valid but can stay positive when the current vanishes; synchronisation is strictly better in this model
product_coupling_nonsharp_separator.model: source {0,1} has positive law lambda=(delta_0+delta_1)/2, target metric d(0,1)=1, and deterministic H=M=identity

synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.same_source_rate_sufficient_condition: d_p^sync<=C_sync*delta_sync^p with w_Z*delta_sync<1 implies sum_p w_Z^p norm(J_p)_(BL*)<=C_sync/(1-w_Z*delta_sync)
synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.scope: one immutable physical source record/rank p at a time, with the actual Jordan source law lambda_p=lambda_p^+-lambda_p^- and the same Round44 Borel hit/miss Markov kernels H_p,M_p
synchronised_hit_miss_pairing.synchronised_coupling: pi_p^sync=integral (H_p(x) tensor M_p(x)) d lambda_p^+(x) + integral (M_p(x) tensor H_p(x)) d lambda_p^-(x)

synchronised_coupling_nonsharp_separator.conclusion: synchronisation can be worse than the normalized product; no global ordering is asserted, while d_p^best remains equal to 1/2
synchronised_coupling_nonsharp_separator.model: source {0,1} has positive law lambda=(delta_0+delta_1)/2, target metric d(0,1)=1, deterministic H=identity and M=flip with M(0)=1,M(1)=0
